name: Brnq
description: Brnq (said brink) is a practice room for the conversations that decide careers: interviews, standups, telling a senior leader no. You speak out loud to an AI panel that plays the people in the room, each with a voice, a role and a goal they won't tell you. Then a debrief shows how each of them heard you, points at your exact words, and gives you one thing to fix. Built around one rule: no score without the evidence behind it.

name: Omnistant
description: An autonomous personal-context agent. It watches a camera feed, remembers where your things were last seen, and catches you at the door with what you're about to leave without. Google ADK and Gemini over an append-only Postgres log, live on Cloud Run — built solo in seven days on one rule: the model never sources a fact.

name: VegaIntel
description: A Prediction Market Intelligence Engine that explains why a Polymarket price moved, not just that it did. A Go MCP server exposes market data and a deterministic signal engine for whale, skew and volume activity; a Python ADK agent turns those signals into a cited explanation with a confidence score, then scores itself against the actual price 48 hours later.

name: Trippy
description: An agentic application for international travel.

name: MergeOracle
description: A CLI that analyzes GitHub issues and PRs, summarizes the conversation, suggests a fix, and drafts a response for you.
